warnings: The inAssets, outAssets and movements fields describe ERC20 Transfer events, not measured before-and-after balances. Separately measured balanceChanges, when available, describe those balances. Events alone are not proof of a balance change.
Security has not been assessed. Successful execution is not a safety verdict.
Lending coverage reconciles cash and position events with the verified scaled-token implementation. Separately measured balanceChanges are required to verify actual balances.
This is historical execution evidence, not a prediction of execution against current state.
Variable-debt token events represent a non-transferable liability. They are preserved in raw movements and positionChanges, and excluded from spendable incoming/outgoing assets.
Position Mint/Burn totals include accrued interest already reflected in balanceOf. The implied position change removes this interest.
Approval calldata describes a request; Approval events describe emitted evidence. Neither independently verifies the final on-chain allowance.
Maximum uint256 approval observations describe spender exposure, not maliciousness. No general security verdict or spender reputation assessment is provided.

Balances are queried independently immediately before and after the original transaction, at its exact position in the original block. The original call is validated separately; no balance probes are inserted into that replay.
USDC cash, hUSDC supplied positions and non-transferable USDC debt are reported separately. Reserve custody balances are not user wealth.
This measurement covers only the involved accounts and these three configured tokens; it does not assess transaction security or predict future blocks.
The measured position delta differs from the cash amount and exactly matches the trace-reconciled scaled-token rounding and interest accounting.
Historical allowance measurement is not implemented. This replay returns permission observations only; its balance measurements do not verify allowances.
